White-label AI applications integration demo

A Microsoft-ready reconciliation workbench for higher education.

This showcase turns a common SIS and enterprise-platform problem into a usable product: deterministic rules clear the easy cases, Azure AI-style recommendations explain the residuals, and every human decision becomes an audit-ready record.

Prepared by Avva Thach, M.S., PCC AI Applications Integration Enterprise Platforms
Open workbench

Problem

Reconciliation work hides in spreadsheets.

Identity, course, term, and transaction records drift across systems. Manual review is slow, inconsistent, and difficult to defend during audit or cutover.

Solution

Rules first. AI only where judgment is still needed.

The workbench clears deterministic matches, routes residual exceptions, explains recommendations, and captures every decision with reviewer identity and timestamp.

Benefit

Cleaner data, faster decisions, stronger governance.

Leaders get throughput, exception categories, adoption metrics, and a reusable Microsoft integration pattern for future AI-enabled workflows.

What turns this MVP into a Microsoft tenant build

Implementation path
1. Register app

Configure Entra enterprise app, redirect URI, app roles, and Conditional Access.

2. Scope data access

Use least-privilege Graph permissions and SIS/LMS API credentials approved by system owners.

3. Govern AI use

Deploy Azure AI inside the approved tenant boundary with logging, retention, and evaluation controls.

4. Report adoption

Publish Power BI/Fabric measures for throughput, exception aging, usage, and audit coverage.

Research inputs

Public sources used to ground the MVP

  • iAvva AI public positioning for white-label service language and founder-led AI transformation framing.
  • UCI Student Performance and OULAD for public higher-education-style table patterns. The app uses fictional records only.
  • Microsoft Learn references for Entra SSO, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint list writes, and Power BI embedded analytics.
